provenance.disclaimer: All metrics below are self-consistency scores evaluated on held-out synthetic data, NOT real-world accuracy. These models were trained and evaluated on algorithmically-generated data calibrated to agronomic literature. They must be calibrated with regional weighbridge records and farm audit data before commercial contracting.
agronomic_references: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Rice-Wheat cropping system stubble ratios
Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) biomass co-firing economics
VIIRS 375m active fire cluster proximity distributions
provenance.intended_use: Demonstration, planning, and price guidance for brick kiln co-firing. Must be calibrated with regional weighbridge and farm audit records before commercial contracting.

yield_predictor.evaluation_note: Trained and evaluated on synthetic data only. Not validated against real harvest measurements.
